stages.name: initial

public_feedback.scope: Public request inputs only; no held-out verdict is supplied.

blocks.source_excerpt: void initialize(void) { a=b=c=d=k=l=r=bad=0; enabled=1; a=1; b=1; }
blocks.correspondence: The zero-initialization sets c, d, k, l, r, and bad to 0; the later assignments set a and b to 1 while enabled remains 1.
The ISR assigns 2 to a and b.
This step stores the return value of gate() in k. gate() disables interrupts and returns the key computed from enabled.
This step calls ungate with 255 to update enabled.
This step copies a into c.
This step copies b into d.
This step calls ungate with the saved key k to update enabled.
This step sets bad to the result of comparing c and d for inequality.
